title: Content Brief
description: Brief for one content piece, written by /keyword-research to ./campaigns/content-plan/{keyword-slug}.md and read by /seo-content. Each property maps to one heading of the markdown template in _system/content-brief.md.

title.description: Recommended article title, e.g. 'The Complete Guide to Cold Email for Freelancers'.

created_date.description: ISO 8601 date the brief was written. Markdown: the date on the Last Updated line.

created_by.description: Skill that wrote the brief, typically '/keyword-research'. Markdown: the skill on the Last Updated line.

cluster_ref.description: Keyword cluster in ./brand/keyword-plan.md this brief belongs to, e.g. 'Cold Email Templates'.

target_keyword.description: Primary keyword this content targets, e.g. 'cold email template freelancer'.

secondary_keywords.description: 2-5 supporting keywords to work in naturally.

long_tail_keywords.description: 3-5 long-tail variations of the target keyword.

keyword_metrics.description: Search metrics for the target keyword. Mark estimates per the data-quality label in _system/brand-memory.md.

cpc.description: Cost per click in USD, indicating commercial value.

search_intent.description: Dominant search intent for the target keyword.

content_type.description: Content format, chosen from what ranks for the keyword.

target_word_count.description: Word count range from the ranking pages, e.g. '2,500-3,000'.

audience.description: Who searches this keyword and what they need, informed by ./brand/audience.md.

angle.description: How this piece approaches the topic given the brand's positioning (./brand/positioning.md).

serp_analysis.description: The current search results for the target keyword.

top_results.description: The top-ranking pages, usually the top 3.

title.description: Page title as shown in the results.

content_type.description: Format of the ranking page, e.g. 'listicle', 'guide', 'tool page'.

word_count.description: Approximate word count of the ranking page.

assessment.description: What the page does well and where it falls short.

serp_features.description: Result-page features present, e.g. 'featured snippet', 'video carousel'.

people_also_ask.description: People Also Ask questions the piece answers.

content_gaps.description: What the ranking pages miss and this piece fills.

differentiation.description: What this piece brings that ranking pages lack: proprietary data, a unique method, practitioner experience.

key_points.description: Points and elements the piece must cover to compete, e.g. 'pricing comparison table', 'real cold email examples'.

outline.description: Recommended H2/H3 outline, built from People Also Ask and the logical flow.

guidance.description: What this section covers and why.

keywords_to_include.description: Secondary keywords to work into this section.

voice_notes.description: Adjustments to ./brand/voice-profile.md for this piece, e.g. 'More authoritative than usual: this is a definitive guide'.

from.description: Existing pages that should link to this piece.

cta.description: The action the reader takes after reading.

text.description: CTA copy, e.g. 'Download the Cold Email Template Kit'.

placement.description: Where the CTA goes, e.g. 'after intro and at the end'.

output_path.description: Where the finished content will be written, e.g. './campaigns/content/cold-email-template-freelancer.md'.

path.description: Path or URL of the linked page, or the planned brief's slug.

context.description: Where in the article the link goes.
